主要内容: Geospace Technologies Corporation (GEOSPACE) dismissed BDO USA, LLP as its independent registered accounting firm effective February 27, 2018. The Audit Committee and Board of Directors approved the dismissal. The company appointed RSM US LLP as its new independent registered public accounting firm for the fiscal year ending September 3, 2018. BDO’s audit reports for fiscal years ended September 30, 2017 and 2016 did not contain adverse opinions or disclaimers, but included an adverse opinion on internal control over financial reporting due to a material weakness in inventory classification. No disagreements with BDO occurred during the past two fiscal years or through February 27, 2018, regarding accounting principles, financial disclosures, or audit scope and procedures. The company disclosed a material weakness in its internal controls related to the classification of current assets with respect to inventories, as reported in its Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended September 30, 2017. The disclosure is part of the Form 8-K filing with the SEC on March 1, 2018, signed by Thomas T. McEntire, Vice President, Secretary, and Chief Financial Officer of GEOSPACE TECHNOLOGIES CORPORATION.
